name: universal-payment-qr
description: Monorepo for UniPayScan — open-source payment QR detection, validation, and normalization across fiat and crypto.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target web --out-dir ../../packages/core/generated --out-name index --release && wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target nodejs --out-dir ../../packages/core/generated-node --out-name index --release && node scripts/prepare-wasm-package.mjs
scripts.build:packages: tsup packages/core/src/index.ts packages/core/src/node.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir packages/core/dist --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --external ../generated/index.js --external ../generated-node/index.js && tsup packages/scanner/src/index.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir packages/scanner/dist --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --external @zxing/browser && tsup packages/react/src/index.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir packages/react/dist --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --external react --external unipayscan --external @universal-payment-qr/scanner && tsup bindings/react-native/src/index.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir bindings/react-native/dist --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/distribute-packages.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && npm run build:packages && vite build apps/playground
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:packages && vite build apps/playground
